Name: Prismatic Valley Framework
Author: JollyAxolotl
Description:
What began as a mod to let a friend have their prismatic dino pants became a framework to let others play with the prismatic effect on other object types.[b] Prismatic Valley Framework[/b] allows mod authors to add an override color to apply to their objects in game with Content Patcher alone. This includes static colors, the Stardew prismatic effect, and even custom prismatic effects. No C# or non-CP configuration required.

Prismatic Valley Framework currently supports the following types:
[list]
[*]Farm animals
[*]Items (e.g. animal products, artifacts, etc.)
[*]Big craftables
[*]Boots
[/list]This mod doesn't do anything on its own. You need to install supporting Content Patcher content packs separately.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/212901518-1718842381.png[/img][url=https://smapi.io]
[/url][list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Download the mod.
[*]Unzip the mod folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/212901518-1718842430.png[/img]
Prismatic Valley Framework lets you assign override colors by adding Prismatic Valley Framework fields to the CustomFields field of the object you are creating/modifying. See the [url=https://github.com/Jolly-Alpaca/PrismaticValleyFramework/blob/main/README.md]read me[/url] for more information.

If there is an unsupported object type you'd like to be implemented, contact me. I'd love to add support for more object types, if other mod authors would like to use them.

If you notice the color override not being applied somewhere, let me know. Some objects are drawn from multiple places, so it's possible I may have missed a patch.

Note: Custom boots are not compatible with Fashion Sense since Fashion Sense suppresses the vanilla draw function if any Fashion Sense gear is equipped.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/212901518-1718849969.png[/img]﻿
[list]
[*]Add support for additional object types
[list][*]Pets
[*]Furniture
[*]Crops
[*]Fish
[*]Etc.
[/list][/list][list][*]Add additional configuration options
[list][*]Offset: Vary the start point for the prismatic effect so not every prismatic effect matches
[*]Speed Multiplier: Vary the speed of the prismatic effect
[/list][/list][list][*]Add support for layered textures
[list][*]Support textures split between two sprites to allow different color overrides to be applied to different parts of the texture. An example of this are the multi-colored flower crops. The texture is split between the leaves/stems and the flowers, allowing different colors to be applied to the flowers without affecting the color of the leaves/stems.
[/list][/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/212901518-1718842326.png[/img]﻿
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/Jolly-Alpaca/PrismaticValleyFramework]Source Code[/url]
[*]Check out my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25342]Prismatic Dinosaur[/url]﻿ mod to see this framework in action! 
[list][*]Note: The prismatic Pepper Rex is [b]not[/b] part of this framework as each individual monster type handles its own draws. Not to mention new monsters will likely require some C# anyway.
[/list][/list]
